issues: previously disclosed as a defective source image; resolved 2026-08-10. The white-top/black-bottom raster was a rendering fault, not a scan defect: this page's embedded JPEG is 1-channel grayscale while the PDF declares the XObject /DeviceRGB, so MuPDF read 3 bytes per pixel out of 1-byte-per-pixel data. pdf_to_images.py now decodes the embedded scan directly when that mismatch is present

re-rasterized image is uniformly white across the whole canvas (a single distinct luminance value) - a genuine blank page, matching Tricolore 1 page 179. Nothing to transcribe; content_type set to [] to match that book's blank-page convention rather than the non-taxonomy [defective-image] value used before
